title: Driver Profile
instructions:
Write a function called `driverProfile` that takes two parameters: `name` (String) and `teamNumber` (Int). It should return a string in this exact format:

"Driver: {name}, Team #{teamNumber}"

For example, `driverProfile("Alex", 4488)` should return `"Driver: Alex, Team #4488"`.
expectedOutput:
Driver: Alex, Team #4488
Driver: Jordan, Team #254
